t.DISODIUM_EDTA.agn: It is not in the annexes of the EU Cosmetics Regulation; there is no specific limit or labelling rule.
t.DISODIUM_EDTA.eff.0: No known side effect in normal use (CIR, 2002). It has been noted that it may increase the skin penetration of other substances.
t.DISODIUM_EDTA.summary: An auxiliary ingredient that binds metal ions.
t.DISODIUM_EDTA.what: Binds calcium, magnesium and other metal ions in water; preserves the product's colour, scent and texture.
